children: Meta Platforms (META) reports Q3 earnings Oct 28. Estimates: ~$6.35 EPS on ~$63.3B revenue vs prior year $7.25 EPS and $51.24B revenue.
Wells Fargo lifted META target to $1,000 from $796; Deutsche Bank raised target to $820; Piper Sandler kept Overweight with a higher target. META traded near $723 on Oct. 7.
Meta plans to reserve 500 MW of compute for its internal AI project Muse, which could cut 2027 revenue by about $5 billion unless Muse is monetized and widely adopted.
Meta (META) plans a unified AI stack linking ads, Muse agent and Meta Enterprise Platform. Cited 3.6 billion daily users and expects AI tools and infrastructure to boost revenue over quarters.
Meta Platforms (META) launched Muse AI on Sept. 8; the app hit No.1 on the U.S. Apple App Store and Google Play, drawing strong investor interest.
META joins Walmart, Stripe and Sierra in a Bret Taylor-led effort to set AI agent standards for privacy, security, data access and transaction protocols affecting consumer–retailer interactions.
Meta Platforms (META) named Chirantan Desai Chief Enterprise Platform Officer. Desai, from MongoDB/Cloudflare/ServiceNow, will lead and scale Meta's enterprise platform initiative.
META joined a $300M investment into Biohub’s $1.8B raise to fund open biological AI training datasets; deal links Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg to the project.
Stanford neuroscientist Andrew Huberman says Meta Platforms (META) could enter biotech, pursuing non‑invasive brain‑reading and brain‑writing technologies as AI firms expand into neuroscience.
